Phase 1. Official NOAA test vectors for WMM2025 and WMMHR2025, each run against its own
coefficient set; one case per altitude datum plus `UNKNOWN` (§10.2); dates at the start,
middle and end of each validity interval plus one outside it to confirm refusal (§10).
See `../README.md` and `../../third_party/noaa-wmm/UPSTREAM.md`.
